text: The first path's second unit opens with two lessons: 'Meet the library: nine kinds of books' (high-level overviews of the nine groups: what each contains, how to read it, where to begin) and 'How to read what you're reading' (kinds of biblical writing and the claim each makes; contested passages shown with the views side by side; 'not literal' never means 'not true')
rationale: The primary learner asked for a basic book-by-book overview of what the books are and how to read them; category overviews suffice
